scope: Kaufmann 077v–084r inclusive: end of Taanit, Megillah, Chagigah and Moed Katan; every supplied source title on boundary pages included.
method: Original full pages viewed, then all 28 native full-column crops independently transcribed as main consonantal attempts before source binding. Mandatory unique exact consonant LCS anchors bind reliable matches; unaligned attempts are preserved unchanged. Only explicitly recorded individual points were compared afterward against strict Accordance transfer reference.
coordinateConvention: Original native image pixels, [left,top,right,bottom]. Bboxes are full columns or inspected point regions, not word rectangles.

limitations: All 28 main columns were visually read and typed as consonantal attempts. This is distinct from complete vowel-by-vowel certification.
Independent AI visual transcriptions can misread letters, omit text or mis-segment words. An exact consonant match against source is not independent human confirmation.
Unmatched typed strings are attempts, not established manuscript variants. They may include mistakes, different segmentation, headings, line-end fragments, additions or corrections.
Correction layers, marginalia and punctuation were visible but were not exhaustively or palaeographically attributed. No editorial running-text replacement follows from this review.
Unrecorded point marks are unresolved, not absent. Full vowels, dagesh, rafe, shin/sin marks and meteg remain open except the individual positive features recorded.
The scanned points are small, faded or affected by texture in many regions; enlargement does not create new source detail.
All exact-match anchors are consonantal only. They cannot be reported as full manuscript vocalization agreement with Accordance.
The underlying Kaufmann text, pointing, morphology and translations were not changed.
completionStatus: All assigned originals and both full main columns actually read and attempted. Bound consonantal positions are counted separately from unresolved source positions. Full word-by-word pointing collation remains unfinished.
unreviewedWordIdsMeaning: Source positions without mandatory unique source-bound consonantal observations; containing main columns were attempted, but these positions remain unresolved. All word-pointing positions remain incompletely reviewed.
